text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The Ziz, in a state of agitation,
chases after the trio as they flee the village.
text_block_list.orig_text:
興奮状態のジズは、村から出た{0}たちを、
追い続けていた。

text_block_list.name: Ziz
text_block_list.text: KKKKRRRSSSKKKRR!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
It's generating [i]this[/i] much wind pressure
just from flapping its wings... Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい風圧……
ジズが羽ばたくだけでこんなに……
はぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Ziz
text_block_list.text: KKKKRRRSSSKKKRR!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: It's just going to keep blowing my arrows away...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりこの風圧じゃ、
矢が届かない──！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Haha... Sure seems like it's ticked off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは……
あの鳥さん、
かなり怒っちゃってるね……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: We won't stand a chance unless we have a proper plan.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにか、
策を考えないと……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
*huff, huff*
You two okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
二人とも、大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... I'm... fi—
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん……
だいじょ、
あぅ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Shiorin!
Should we take a break?
You haven't gotten any rest this whole time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリン！
　
ずっと動きっぱなしだったもんね……
少し休む？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. We're almost there...
But this is going to be our toughest foe yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
平気だよお姉ちゃん……
あと一匹だけだもん……
けど、
その一匹が一筋縄じゃいかない……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
My arrows are useless so long as it's stirring up this much wind....
We can't approach it like we did the other monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジズの羽ばたきによる風圧で、
普通に矢を射るんじゃ攻撃は届かない。
今までの魔物とは段違いに強い……
どうすれば……

text_block_list.name: Ziz
text_block_list.text: KKKKRRRSSSKKKRR!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune & Shiori
text_block_list.text: Eeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: キャーッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Sh-Shiorin! We can bypass the wind if I amplify
your attacks with my magic, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シ、シオリン！
　私がシオリンの攻撃を魔法で強化するよ！
それなら風圧にだって負けないよね！？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
We can, but I still won't be able to aim properly!
And we're bound to get hit if I miss even a single shot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもお姉ちゃん！
　この風圧じゃ狙いが定まらないよ！
一度でも外したら、
ジズの攻撃を受けちゃう！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: No way! What're supposed to do—
choice_data_list: I'll use the book to draw its attention to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなぁ！
　じゃあどうしたら──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: W-we can't let you do that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなのだめだよ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: It's far too dangerous! If anything, I'll—
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうです、
危険すぎます！
　
囮なら私が……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
{0}...
Okay.
Just... promise us you won't do anything reckless.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……{0}さん……
わかりました……
けど、
絶対に無茶だけはしないでください……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}...
Okay. You got it! J-just don't be afraid to run if it comes to it!
We absolutely don't want you dying on us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……わかった、
信じるよ！
で、でも、
危なくなったら逃げてね！
　死んじゃイヤだからね！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: This is bad...!
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしよう──！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Th-there's super duper power swelling up in me!
Is {0} responsible?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわわわ！
　きゅ、急に力が湧いて！
{0}くんのおかげ！？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness he's all right...
Thank you! This should be more than enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事だったんですね……
ありがとうございます、
これなら！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Hatsune!
text_block_list.orig_text: お姉ちゃん──！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I'm all charged up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法、
フルチャージ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ready when you are, Shiorin!
text_block_list.orig_text: いけるよシオリン！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: It all come to an end... Right here, right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで……
終わりにする！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Let's show this feathery foe what happens when we go all out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見せてあげよ！
　私たちのフルパワー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune & Shiori
text_block_list.text: Taaake thiiis!
text_block_list.orig_text: いっけええええ！

text_block_list.name: Ziz
text_block_list.text: KKKSSSHRRRHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Bull's-eye!
text_block_list.orig_text: 当たった！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: No gust, no gale is strong enough to stop the three of us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たち３人の力は、
風になんて負けない！

text_block_list.name: Ziz
text_block_list.text: KKKSSSHRRRKKK...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Now then...
text_block_list.orig_text: 術式が……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: The Ziz... has officially be re-sealed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
封印……
完了です。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
We did it... We really did it!
Shiorin! That was [i]so[/i] cool!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった……
やったやったー！
すごいよシオリン！
　今の見たー！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Your arrow and my magic went all pew pew pew!
It was super duper coolio!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリンの矢と私の魔法がビューって！
すごいすごいすごーい！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you and {0}...
Thank you so much. The book itself should be back to norma— Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
お姉ちゃんと{0}さんの力があったから……
本当にありがとう。
これで、
図鑑はもとに戻って……
あれ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: What's up?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしたのシオリン？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Oh no. That arrow went flying off into the distance...
And the bookmark was attached to it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや……
矢が回収できないところまで飛んでちゃって……
その矢にブックマークがついてるから……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ああああああああ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
N-now what? Those monsters will
break free again if we don't get the bookmark back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どうしようお姉ちゃん、
あれを回収しないと
また魔物が！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
L-leave it to me!
I'll go fetch it for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、まかせてシオリン！
お姉ちゃんがすぐに取りに行ってくるから！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Hatsune, wait!
Off she goes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　お姉ちゃん！
……行っちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: I, uh... I hope she knows where it is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもお姉ちゃん……
場所わかるのかな？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh!
Why'd I teleport when I don't even know where it is?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわーん！
　テレポートしたのはいいけど
ブックマークどこー！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And thus Hatsune was tasked with searching for a needle in a haystack.
text_block_list.orig_text: その後、必死にブックマークを探す羽目になったハツネであった。
